strings.site.tagline: A computer that's on your side.
strings.site.description: Freally OS starts in seconds, runs only what you asked for, and every line of it is written in-house. A new desktop operating system in Rust, open source under Apache-2.0. Nothing to download before 1.0.
strings.footer.licence: Open source under the Apache License 2.0. © Mike Weaver. The Freally name, icons and look are not covered by the code's licence.
strings.footer.yours: Your files and accounts stay on your computer. Freally OS sends nothing anywhere unless you ask it to.
